newsitem.title: USA: Payless Cashways seeks talks with lenders.
newsitem.headline: Payless Cashways seeks talks with lenders.

text.p: Payless Cashways Inc said Tuesday that, while it continues to have adequate liquidity and remains in compliance with bank loan covenants, it has scheduled discussions with bank lenders at the end of this month on a restructuring of its bank debt.
The building materials specialty retailer said it had $56.1 million available under its various credit lines at the end of the second quarter.

"...(T)he company's debt load has limited our flexibility and our balance sheet needs to be addressed," David Stanley, chairman, said in a statement. "That is the purpose of our bank meetings later this month."
Earlier, Payless Cashways reported a loss for the second quarter ended May 31 of $0.37 a share, compared with a year-ago profit of $0.11.
Second quarter results included a $12.1 million in taxes paid, compared with $5.3 million a year ago.
Stanley said that over the next several months, Payless Cashways will intensify efforts to reduce costs and enhance revenues.
